security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Shielded Zcash wallet for znfts (ZMAP shielded objects)
bundle.longDescription: Zecboat is a desktop Zcash wallet that holds, verifies and transfers znfts: Zcash non-fungible things, each one shielded note carrying one named unit under ZMAP. It syncs over lightwalletd gRPC and keeps spending keys encrypted on disk. It does not mint.
